Card Q&A.q: Can the Digimon I specify to suspend be different from the opponent's Digimon that can't unsuspend for this card's [On Play] effect?

Effect: [On Play] Suspend 1 of your opponent's Digimon. Then, 1 of their Digimon can't unsuspend until the end of their turn.
Inherited Effect: ＜Piercing＞ (When this Digimon attacks and deletes your opponent's Digimon in battle, it checks security before the attack ends.)
